implementation: Extend the private immutable raw baseline with owned live source codec metadata: bounded canonical page, selected text/codepage policies, compatibility classifier and normalized codec version. Capture from getDxfReadContext during the actual callback, never from the mutable final header; match source revision/binary context and precharge owned profile bytes before copies. Shared const baseline identity freezes this profile with its raw body.

Allow the existing DICTIONARYVAR transaction for R14+ canonical and application owners under the existing graph/unique-membership rules. Keep the existing raw-writer exact-source-revision constraint. Re-decode original/current bodies using the captured source context and verify its codec revision; do not reinterpret the original bytes through a subsequently edited header.

Plan the output codec with the writer-equivalent target header selection, using bounded borrowed declaration text before copying. Encode value1 for the selected version/page/binary profile and owning-decode the planned projection. Freeze the selected header declaration and actual output version/effective codepage/binary profile against callback drift.

Retain ASCII opaque transport through legacy page changes but refuse unknown non-ASCII fields that would acquire a different page interpretation. Same-page corrected retries remain admitted. This is a byte-preservation boundary, not general opaque semantic transcoding.

Use effective UTF8 for modern DXF even when the header/codec reports legacy metadata. Review reproduced a failure of existing modern inspector replay and a potential false refusal of opaque UTF8 fields; the corrected guard separates modern body encoding from legacy metadata. Two explicit modern unknown-field controls retain UTF8 payloads across changed codepage metadata.

Extend the optional independent recipe with R2000/R2004 variable/LINE profiles in three legacy pages. The C++ probe verifies the independently generated input value before editing; the peer independently reads unchanged/edited output strings, dictionary/variable owners and 3D line endpoints. Three unused default materials are omitted before source generation; original defaults failing at MATERIAL73=0 remain retained and unqualified.

Extend the existing indexed UTF8 override API to explicitly selected group1 strings, retaining index/type/order/UTF8 validation and all unselected raw-text guards. Under RequireLossless, route validated legacy non-ASCII value1 through semantic encoding and match its actual encoded output. Compatible unchanged spellings and ASCII/CIF raw slots retain replay; unknown non-ASCII suffixes still refuse strict publication.

Precharge64 times current/original raw and typed logical storage to include typed edit expansion, semantic overrides and decode temporaries. Two1MiB public edits refuse before preparation copies and recover on the same adapter. Use an explicit missing-slot sentinel so a schema-only insertion cannot turn an absent value into an override of a following unknown field.

No installed header layout/signature, interface callback/pure virtual, DWG parser layout or public text policy changes. Private adapter/header users must rebuild. Shared decoder/writer defaults remain compatible, verified by the retained modern/application/material/consumer cohorts.

limitations: Legacy independent source profiles are R2000/R2004, not an independent R14 native producer run. R14 evidence is authored locally. The three codepage/text specimens do not certify every codepoint, alias, recovery policy, source/header ordering or native application.

The variable-only legacy recipe omits three unused MATERIAL defaults before generation. Initial unmodified producer files fail at the known MATERIAL group73/specular ambiguity; this remains a separate required MATERIAL/specification/version investigation. Neither that default source profile nor full legacy producer documents are promoted.

Different DXF revisions remain refused by the existing raw transport contract. Opaque non-ASCII legacy page changes refuse rather than invent field semantics; arbitrary opaque text encoding/format changes and common/recursive document ownership remain unqualified.

Callback baselines/profile matching and output readback do not establish independent original semantic certification, native setvar/getvar behavior or unknown schema meanings. Source/consumer corpus breadth, SCALE/MLINESTYLE/MLEADERSTYLE transactions, MATERIAL/rendering/TABLE/document closure remain open.

Native Linux GCC release, Linux/Windows FreeCAD, independent ACIS/ACDS semantic/kernel, formal ABI/application and controlled RSS/performance remain NOT_RUN. Archive byte verification is not an extracted-source build or distcheck.
